m: वैनाश n. (fr. वि-नाश) = next n., VarYogay.

s: klI, (vinASaM sUcayatIti । vinASa + Wak .) nAqInakzatraviSezaH । sa tu janmarkzAvaDitrayoviMSanakzatram । yaTA । janmAdyaM karmma tato'pi daSamaM sAMGAtikaM zoqaSaBam । samudayamazwAdaSaBaM vinASasaMjYaM trayoviMSaM AdyAttu paYcaviMSaM mAnasamevaM naraH zaqfkzaH syAt ॥ tatPalaM yaTA, -- “IhAdehArTahAniH syAjjanmarkza upatApite । karmmarkze karmmaRAM hAniH pIqA manasi mAnase ॥ mUrttidraviRabanDUnAM hAniH sAMGAtike taTA । saMtapte sAmudayike mitraBftyArTasaMkzayaH ॥ vEnASike vinASaH syAt dehadraviRasampadAm ॥” iti jyotistattvam ॥ niDanatArA । yaTA, -- “vEnASikarkze dfzwaM grahaRaM suDAMSuBAskarayoH । janayati rogaM bahuDA kleSaM vittakzayaYcASu ॥” vEnASikarkze trayoviMSanakzatre । iti kecit । vastutastu vEnASikapadaM niMDanatArAparam । niDane'pi cetyekavAkyatvAt । iti tiTyAditattvam ॥
puM, (vinASo matamasya । vinASa + Wak । sarvvaM dfSyaM kzaRikamiti kzaRikavijYAnavAditvAdasya taTAtvam .) kzaRikaH । paratantraH । UrRanABaH । iti medinI ॥ vinASasambanDIye, tri ॥
v: pu॰ vinASamaDikftya kfto granTaH Wak । sarvezAM kzaRaBaNguratApratipAdake 1 bOdDAgame 2 tadaBijYe tri॰ । vinASAya hitam Wak । jyAtizokte zaNgAqIcakrasTe janmanakzatrAvaDitrayoviMSe 3 nakzatre 4 kzaRike 5 paratantre ca tri॰ 6 urRanABe pu॰ medi॰ ।
m: वैनाशिक mfn. perishable, L.
believing in complete annihilation, L.
causing destruction or ruin, L.
dependent, L.

the doctrines of the B˚, A.
a dependent, subject, W.
a spider, L.
an astrologer (?), W.
वैनाशिक n. the 23rd Nakṣatra from that under which any one is born, VarYogay.
a: वैनाशिकः — 1 A slave. --2 A spider. --3 An astrologer. --4 The doctrines of the Buddhists. --5 A follower of those doctrines. --कं The twenty-third asterism from that under which any one is born.

वैनायक m. pl. N. of a partic. class of demons = विनायक, BhP.
a: वैनायक — a. (की f.) Belonging to Gaṇeśa; वैनायक्यश्चिरं वो वदनविधुतयः पांतु चीत्कारवत्यः Māl. 1. 1.

m: वैनायक—संहिता f. N. of wk.

s: puM, bOdDaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ yaTA, “BinnakaH kzapaRo'hrIko bOdDo vEnAyikaH smftaH ॥” iti trikARqaSezaH ॥
v: pu॰ vinAyaM KaRqanamaDikftya kfto granTaH Wak । 1 vOdDAgame trikA॰ upacArAt 2 tadaBijYe tri॰ ।

the doctrines of a Buddhist school of philosophy, A.

m: वैन्ध्य mfn. belonging to the Vindhya range, Ragh.

m: वैनीतक m. n. (fr. वि-नीत) a kind of litter, a palanquin &c. (with bearers relieving one another), L.
any indirect means of conveyance (as a porter who carries a sedan-chair, a palanquin-bearer, horse dragging a carriage &c.), W.

k.v: सर्वं स्याद्वाहनं यानं युग्यं पत्रं च धोरणम्. परम्परावाहनं यत्तद्वैनीतकमस्त्रियाम्.।

v: pu॰ vinatAyAH apatyaM Qak । 1 garuqe amaraH 2 aruRe ca matsyapu॰ ।
m: वैनतेय m. (fr. वि-नता) metron. fr. वि-नता, MaitrS.; MBh. (also pl.)

N. of a son of Garuḍa, MBh.
of a poet, Sadukt.
pl. N. of a school, Caraṇ.
a: वैनतेयः — 1 N. of Garuḍa; वैनतेय इव विनतानंदनः K.; R. 11. 59, 16. 88; Bg. 10. 30. --2 N. of Aruṇa.

k.v: गरुत्मान्गरुडस्तार्क्ष्यो वैनतेयः खगेश्वरः। नागान्तको विष्णुरथः सुपर्णः पन्नगाशनः॥

m: वैनत्य n. (fr. वि-नत) humble demeanour, MBh.
वैनव n. N. of a Sāman, ĀrṣBr.

s: puM, SastrAByAsaraTaH । tatparyyAyaH । yogyaraTaH 2 । iti hemacandraH । 3 । 416 ॥ (vinaya eva । “vinayAdiByazWak .” 5 । 4 । 34 । iti svArTe Wak । vinayaH ॥) vinayasambanDini, tri ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 12 । 68 । 4 । “sarvvaM vEnayikaM kftvA vinayajYo bfhaspatim । dakziRAnantaro BUtvA praRamya viDipUrvvakam । viDiM papracCa rAjyasya sarvvalokahite rataH ॥”)
